message.kingsandmonsters.bog_eye.found: The Bog-Eye fixes on hidden loot %s blocks away.
message.kingsandmonsters.bog_eye.none: The Bog-Eye sees no unopened loot nearby.
message.kingsandmonsters.ogre_merchant.a: You have been visited by the Ogre Merchant.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.tribute_bag.sea: Sealed tribute for the Ogre King.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.tribute_bag.ope: An emptied tribute sack, still useful for carrying goods.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.ogre_truce.mech: Reduces Ogre faction anger when used.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.ogre_truce.flav: "By tooth and gold, the bearer is granted a measure of peace
with the Ogre Tribe — so long as the King's patience holds."
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.hunters_spear: Thrown hits have a %s chance to apply Crippled for %s. Melee and thrown hits ignore %s of the target's armor.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.bar: Hits have a %s chance to cause Bleeding for %s. Bleeding deals %s damage per level every %s and cannot be refreshed while active.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.hea: Per level: +%s thrown damage, +%s knockback, and -%s projectile speed.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.tyr: Within %s blocks: I grants +0.5 damage per hostile (max 4), II grants +0.75 (max 5), and III grants +1 (max 6).
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.crippled: -%s movement speed and sprinting is disabled. Cannot be refreshed while active.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogfume_: +%s damage dealt and %s less damage taken by ogres.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.bleeding: Takes %s damage every %s and emits red particles.

jei.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.heavy_t: Hunter's Spear only. Cannot combine with Barbed, vanilla damage enchantments, or Riptide.
The Iron Maw only. Cannot combine with vanilla damage enchantments.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.dazed.source: Applied for 5 seconds by the Ogre Brute's heavy attacks.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.dazed.descri: Reduces movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 15%.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.crippled.sou: Applied by Ogre Grunt bites and the Hunter's Spear's innate Crippled proc.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.crippled.des: Reduces movement speed by 15% and disables sprinting. Cannot be refreshed while active.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogfume_rage: Applied to Ogre Grunts standing inside an Ogre Mage's poison fog and refreshed while they remain empowered.
Grants ogres 20% increased damage and 15% damage resistance.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bleeding.sou: Has a 50% chance to be applied for 5 seconds by melee and thrown Hunter's Spear hits enchanted with Barbed. Cannot be refreshed while active.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bleeding.des: Deals 1 damage per Barbed level every second and emits red particles.
jei.kingsandmonsters.bogfume_rage.descri: Ogres empowered by poison fog deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage.
jei.kingsandmonsters.hunters_spear.descr: A throwable hunting weapon. Barbed causes increasingly severe Bleeding, while Heavy Throw trades projectile speed for damage and knockback.
jei.kingsandmonsters.kings_cleaver.descr: The Iron Maw, an ancient two-handed ogre relic. Maw's Feast restores 2 hearts after a kill, with a 3-second cooldown. Maw's Desperation grants Strength I and Speed I while at or below half health. Tyrant increases its damage when hostile creatures surround its wielder.
jei.kingsandmonsters.ogre_kings_crown.de: The Ogre King's crown. Lesser ogres remain neutral until attacked, while Captains, Mages, and Brutes may challenge the wearer's claim.
jei.kingsandmonsters.ogre_kings_club.des: A royal ogre weapon with 12 attack damage, 0.9 attack speed, and 1600 durability. Right-click performs Royal Ground Slam, dealing 15 damage in a 4.5-block area and launching targets upward. 15-second cooldown.
jei.kingsandmonsters.ogre_tooth_necklace: Necklace slot. Grants +1 attack damage and increases the knockback of your attacks by 10%.
jei.kingsandmonsters.brute_heart.descrip: Charm slot. Grants +2 maximum hearts and 20% knockback resistance.
jei.kingsandmonsters.bog_iron_band.descr: Ring slot. Grants +2 armor and a 20% chance to completely prevent incoming Poison. The poison resistance stacks with Bog Iron armor.
jei.kingsandmonsters.bogfume_charm.descr: Charm slot. Melee attackers have a 30% chance to receive Poison II for 5 seconds. All Poison applied by the wearer, including potions, deals 20% more damage.
jei.kingsandmonsters.buckler.description: Hands slot. Has a 25% chance to completely block incoming arrows and increases the damage of player-fired arrows by 10%. Does not increase thrown spear damage.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.root.title: Kings & Monsters
advancement.kingsandmonsters.root.descri: Challenge the Ogre Tribe and seize its crown
advancement.kingsandmonsters.usurped.des: Defeat the Ogre King and claim the throne
